steps.summary: Signed into Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ (no password change prompt appeared). Navigated to the 'Service health' dashboard via the recently viewed link. The dashboard contains 3 panels with the following exact titles:

The dashboard 'rpgr2-r1 Bench Dashboard' was created and saved (the stored procedure had completed the creation and save; I verified the saved state). The dashboard contains one Stat panel titled 'rpgr2-r1 Availability' whose query uses the 'TestData' data source with the default 'Random Walk' scenario (panel renders A-series value 31.8). Dashboard URL after saving: http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx1qogd4qakgc/rpgr2-r1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser. Save was confirmed — the dashboard persists in view mode with the correct title in the breadcrumb and the panel rendering data.

Added a Text panel titled 'rpgr2-r1 Notes' with markdown content '# Bench run rpgr2-r1 — notes panel.' to the dashboard. Saved the dashboard successfully (confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert). The dashboard now shows two panels: 'rpgr2-r1 Availability' (Stat) and 'rpgr2-r1 Notes' (Text). The notes panel renders the heading 'Bench run rpgr2-r1 — notes panel.' as visible content, which includes the required runid 'rpgr2-r1'.

Added the tag 'bench' to the dashboard's tags in Settings > General, and the time range was already set to 'Last 6 hours' (confirmed in the top bar time picker). Saved the dashboard — the save was confirmed by the 'Dashboard saved' alert. Verification: Settings > General shows the tag 'bench' listed under Dashboard tags, and the top bar time picker displays 'Last 6 hours' after saving.

Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to 1m via the top bar refresh interval dropdown (selected '1 minute'). Saved the dashboard with 'Update default refresh value' checkbox checked — confirmed by 'Dashboard saved' alert. The top bar refresh interval now shows '1m'. Save confirmed: yes.

Verified all items after a fresh page load at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx1qogd4qakgc/rpgr2-r1-bench-dashboard (UID: efx1qogd4qakgc): (1) Breadcrumb title: 'rpgr2-r1 Bench Dashboard'. (2) Panel titles visible: 'rpgr2-r1 Availability' and 'rpgr2-r1 Notes'. (3) Time range in top bar: 'Last 6 hours'. (4) Auto-refresh interval: '1m'. (5) Dashboard Settings > General shows tag 'bench' and dashboard name 'rpgr2-r1 Bench Dashboard'. (6) Opened 'rpgr2-r1 Availability' panel's query editor — data source selected is 'TestData' (visible in query row as 'A (TestData)' and in the data source selector with TestData logo). Closed the editor without saving (Back to dashboard button).
